verdict.rationale: Hummingbird's homepage says the product automates routine work and moves cases between agents and the team, and that it helps disposition alerts using automation. That is a thin first-party hint of in-product agents working alert-driven cases, but nothing describes how they investigate. Missing for 10: documentation of an in-product agent investigating transaction alerts, agent-generated review notes or narratives, detail on agent capabilities and controls, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a ai-native, I can use an in-product agent to investigate transaction alerts and prepare review notes

citations.quote: It automates routine work, moves cases between agents and your team, and keeps every decision defensible.
Screen customers and disposition alerts more intelligently.
